site.name: Pocket Foundry
site.description: A free, open-source launcher that runs the Linux version of Factorio on Android phones.
site.unofficial: Pocket Foundry is not made by or affiliated with Wube Software. Factorio is a trademark of Wube Software.

home.title: Pocket Foundry: Factorio on Android
home.description: Pocket Foundry is a free Android launcher that runs the Linux ARM64 version of Factorio, the full game or the free demo, on the phone's GPU.
home.heading: Factorio on Android
home.lead: Pocket Foundry runs the Linux ARM64 version of Factorio on your phone. Import the full game or the free demo from factorio.com, and the app sets up the rest.

items.title: Install
items.text: Download the APK, or add Pocket Foundry to Obtainium.

items.title: Import your Factorio
items.text: Download the Linux (arm64) version from factorio.com and open it in the app.

items.title: Play
items.text: The app sets up a graphics driver for your phone and starts the game.

phones.heading: Phones

gpus.heading: What each GPU gets
gpus.fallback: If it can't play, the app moves on by itself: the next driver for your GPU, then the Phone's driver, then MobileGlues, then the CPU.

faq.title: Pocket Foundry questions and answers
faq.description: Answers about Pocket Foundry: buying Factorio, phones, offline play, Space Age, mods, controllers and updates.
faq.heading: FAQ

items.q: Is this an Android port of Factorio?
items.a: No. Pocket Foundry is a launcher: the game it runs is the Linux ARM64 build from factorio.com, without emulation. The app doesn't include any part of the game, and it isn't made by Wube.

items.q: Do I need to buy Factorio?
items.a: Not to try it: the free demo works too. For the full game, buy it on factorio.com, or on Steam and link your Steam account on factorio.com. Either way, the file you import is the Linux (arm64) download from factorio.com.
Yes. It's open source under the GPL-3.0, with no ads and no tracking.

items.q: Which phones does it run on?
items.a: Android 10 or later. Phones with a Snapdragon (Adreno 6xx or newer) run it best; the Phones page lists the others people have tried.
On the first start, to download the driver for your GPU. After that, the game plays offline.
Yes. It needs more memory than the base game, so on phones with less of it, set Sprite quality to Medium.
Yes. They run the same Lua as on a computer. Add a mod's zip to Pocket Foundry's folder in the phone's Files app.

items.q: Can I play with a controller or a keyboard?
items.a: Yes. USB and Bluetooth controllers (Xbox, PlayStation, Switch Pro, 8BitDo) and keyboards with a mouse work, and the on-screen controls step aside.
With Obtainium, which installs each new version from GitHub, or by downloading it from GitHub's Releases.

items.q: Something doesn't work. Where do I report it?
items.a: Open an issue on GitHub with what the app's Logs screen shows: its Copy button takes it all.
